## What changed

The box image now ships **Ghostty's terminfo** system-wide, so `ssh` from Ghostty no longer prints `unknown terminal type`.

- Pinned to the version Ghostty 1.2 ships, vendored under `packer/files/`
- `kitty-terminfo` and `ncurses-term` come along for other terminals
- [x] Bake tested on stage
- [ ] Rolled out to every box

| Terminal | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Ghostty | broken | works |
| kitty | broken | works |
| iTerm2 | works | works |

> Boxes pick it up on their next image update; nothing to do by hand.

```sh
infocmp xterm-ghostty | head -1
```
